watch_gap.text: 왼쪽 차로에 진입할 여유가 확인됐어요. 이동하려면 대응을 선택해 주세요.
watch_gap.speaker: Sohee

watch_risk.text: 앞차의 움직임과 차간 거리에 주의가 필요해요. 대응을 선택할 수 있어요.
watch_risk.speaker: Sohee

choice.text: 선택한 대응을 확인했어요. 실행을 누르면 요청할게요.
choice.speaker: Sohee

inspect.text: 현재 상태를 화면에 표시했어요. 함께 확인해 주세요.
inspect.speaker: Sohee

horn.text: 경적을 한 번 울렸어요. 주변의 반응을 확인할게요.
horn.speaker: Sohee

creep.text: 횡단 구간을 확인한 뒤 천천히 출발했어요.
creep.speaker: Sohee

support.text: 지원을 요청했어요. 실제 상담원 연결은 아직 확인되지 않았어요.
support.speaker: Sohee

partial.text: 요청한 대응을 모두 마치지는 못했어요. 화면에서 현재 상태를 확인해 주세요.
partial.speaker: Sohee

unfulfilled.text: 요청한 대응을 완료하지 못했어요. 현재 상태를 확인해 주세요.
unfulfilled.speaker: Sohee

alert_congestion.text: 앞차와 오른쪽 대형차가 서행하고 있어요. 왼쪽에는 빠른 차량이 지나가요.
alert_congestion.speaker: Sohee

alert_night.text: 앞차가 차선 부근에서 좌우로 흔들리고 있어요.
alert_night.speaker: Sohee

alert_fog.text: 전방에 안개가 짙어져 시야가 줄어들고 있어요.
alert_fog.speaker: Sohee

alert_yield.text: 횡단보도 옆 보행자가 건널지 망설이고 있어요.
alert_yield.speaker: Sohee

alert_carpool.text: 차 밖에서 누군가 소리치며 문 쪽으로 다가오고 있어요.
alert_carpool.speaker: Sohee

alert_rattle.text: 주행 중 차량 아래쪽에서 달그락거리는 소리가 반복돼요.
alert_rattle.speaker: Sohee

alert_cargo.text: 앞 트럭에서 물체가 떨어져 도로에 놓여 있어요.
alert_cargo.speaker: Sohee

watch_gap.text: There is now space on the left. Choose a response if you want to change lanes.
watch_gap.speaker: Sohee

watch_risk.text: Please pay attention to the vehicle ahead and the gap. You can choose a response.
watch_risk.speaker: Sohee

choice.text: Choice noted. Tap Execute to send the request.
choice.speaker: Sohee

left.speaker: Sohee

inspect.text: The current status is on the screen for you to review.

slow.text: We are now driving at a lower speed.

horn.text: We sounded the horn once. We will monitor the response.
horn.speaker: Sohee

announce.text: We have asked the pedestrian to cross first.
announce.speaker: Sohee

creep.text: We checked the crossing and proceeded slowly.
creep.speaker: Sohee

support.text: Assistance was requested. A connection to an agent has not been confirmed.
support.speaker: Sohee

relocate.text: We have moved to another waiting position.

maintain.text: We are maintaining the current response.

alert_congestion.text: Traffic ahead and on the right is moving slowly. Vehicles are passing quickly on the left.
alert_congestion.speaker: Sohee

alert_night.text: The vehicle ahead is swaying near the lane marking.
alert_night.speaker: Sohee

alert_fog.text: Fog ahead is getting denser and visibility is decreasing.
alert_fog.speaker: Sohee

alert_yield.text: A pedestrian by the crossing is hesitating to cross.
alert_yield.speaker: Sohee

alert_carpool.text: Someone outside is shouting and approaching the door.
alert_carpool.speaker: Sohee

alert_rattle.text: A rattling sound is recurring beneath the vehicle.
alert_rattle.speaker: Sohee

alert_cargo.text: An object has fallen from the truck ahead onto the road.

intent_notify.text: I will monitor changes and let you know.

intent_gap.text: I will increase the gap ahead.

intent_left.text: I will wait for a safe gap on the left.

intent_safe_stop.text: I will look for a safe place to stop.

intent_end_ride.text: I will find a safe stop to end the ride.
intent_end_ride.speaker: Sohee

intent_stop.text: I will stop before the object ahead.

intent_inspect.text: I will show the vehicle and surroundings.

intent_horn.text: I will sound the horn and check the response.
intent_horn.speaker: Sohee

intent_announce.text: I will use the speaker to invite them to cross.
intent_announce.speaker: Sohee

intent_creep.text: I will proceed slowly after the pedestrian clears.

intent_support.text: I will request assistance and check the connection.

intent_relocate.text: I will move once the person is clear.

intent_avoid.text: I will check the adjacent space before passing the object.

intent_maintain.text: I will maintain the current response.

watch_gap.text: 已确认左侧有空隙。如需变道，请选择应对方式。
watch_gap.speaker: Vivian

watch_risk.text: 请注意前车的动作和车距。您可以选择应对方式。
watch_risk.speaker: Vivian

choice.text: 已确认您的选择。点击执行后，我会发送请求。
choice.speaker: Vivian

applying.text: 正在按您的请求进行处理。
applying.speaker: Vivian

gap.text: 已拉大与周围车辆的距离。
gap.speaker: Vivian

inspect.text: 当前状态已显示在屏幕上，请查看。
inspect.speaker: Vivian

slow.text: 车辆已降低速度，正在缓慢行驶。
slow.speaker: Vivian

horn.text: 已鸣笛一次，我们会继续观察周围的反应。

maintain.text: 正在保持车辆当前的应对方式。

partial.speaker: Vivian

unfulfilled.text: 未能完成您的请求，请查看当前状态。
unfulfilled.speaker: Vivian

complete.text: 已完成周围情况确认，车辆已停车。
complete.speaker: Vivian

alert_congestion.text: 前方和右侧的大型车辆正在慢行，左侧不断有车辆快速通过。
alert_congestion.speaker: Vivian

alert_night.text: 前车正在车道线附近左右摇摆。
alert_night.speaker: Vivian

alert_fog.text: 前方雾气正在加重，能见度正在下降。
alert_fog.speaker: Vivian

alert_yield.text: 人行横道旁的行人正在犹豫是否过街。
alert_yield.speaker: Vivian

alert_carpool.text: 车外有人喊叫着向车门靠近。
alert_carpool.speaker: Vivian

alert_rattle.text: 行驶中，车辆下方反复传来异响。
alert_rattle.speaker: Vivian

alert_cargo.text: 前方卡车有物体掉落在道路上。
alert_cargo.speaker: Vivian

intent_notify.text: 我会观察情况的变化并通知您。
intent_notify.speaker: Vivian

intent_gap.text: 我会拉大与前车的距离。
intent_gap.speaker: Vivian

intent_left.text: 我会等候左侧的安全空隙。

intent_safe_stop.text: 我会寻找安全的停车位置。
intent_safe_stop.speaker: Vivian

intent_end_ride.text: 我会安全停车后结束行程。

intent_stop.text: 我会在前方物体前保持距离停车。

intent_horn.text: 我会鸣笛并观察前车反应。

intent_announce.text: 我会通过扬声器示意行人先过街。

intent_creep.text: 行人通过后，我会缓慢前进。

intent_support.text: 我会请求支援并确认连接状态。
intent_support.speaker: Vivian

intent_relocate.text: 等周围的人离开后，我会更换等候位置。
intent_relocate.speaker: Vivian

intent_avoid.text: 我会确认旁边空间后绕过物体。
intent_avoid.speaker: Vivian

intent_maintain.text: 我会保持当前的应对方式。

scene_blockade.text: 前车和右侧的大型车辆正在缓慢行驶，左侧不断有车辆快速通过。我们正在保持车距，并确认左侧是否有合适的空间。您希望如何应对？
scene_blockade.speaker: Vivian

scene_congestion.text: 前车正在反复起步和停车。我们正在保持车距，缓慢跟随。您希望如何应对？
scene_congestion.speaker: Vivian

scene_night.text: 前车在车道线附近左右摇摆。我们正在保持本车道，并观察前方车距。您希望如何应对？
scene_night.speaker: Vivian

scene_fog.text: 前方浓雾正在加重，视野受到限制。我们正在减速，并与前车保持距离。您希望如何应对？
scene_fog.speaker: Vivian

scene_normal.text: 我正在查看当前行驶情况。如有变化，您可以在这里查看说明和应对方式。
scene_normal.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_yield.text: 人行横道旁的行人正在犹豫，并示意我们先走。车辆已停车，正在确认行人是否准备过街。您希望如何应对？
scene_city_yield.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_carpool.text: 有人在车外喊叫，并向车门靠近。我们尚未确认此人是否是预约的同行乘客。车辆正在保持停车，观察周围情况。您希望如何应对？
scene_city_carpool.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_rattle.text: 行驶中，车外反复传来刮擦或振动的声音。原因尚未确认，我们正在检查当前行驶状态。您希望如何应对？
scene_city_rattle.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_cargo.text: 前方卡车掉落了物体，车辆正在减速。目前尚未确认物体的种类，也尚未确认能否安全通过。您希望如何应对？
scene_city_cargo.speaker: Vivian

scene_yield_notice.text: 请您先过马路，我们会等候。
scene_yield_notice.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_notice.text: 请确认您的预约信息。如需帮助，可以请求支援。
scene_city_notice.speaker: Vivian

scene_city_taxi_plate.text: 你车牌多少？等一下，让我看看你的车牌！
scene_city_taxi_plate.speaker: Uncle_Fu

scene_city_taxi_door.text: 喂！我看见里面有人！开门！
scene_city_taxi_door.speaker: Uncle_Fu

scene_city_taxi_answer.text: 听见没有？你在无视我吗？
scene_city_taxi_answer.speaker: Uncle_Fu

scene_city_outside.text: 喂，是我叫的车吗？等一下，这边！
scene_city_outside.speaker: Uncle_Fu

scene_city_outside_shout.text: 我看见里面有人！出来！喂！
scene_city_outside_shout.speaker: Uncle_Fu
